name: blog-post-page
title: Blog post page
description: A blog post: the trail and the title centred, a wide dark panel as the picture, who it is from and when, the text in one narrow column, a link on, then more posts from the category.
never: A sidebar beside the text: the column is the page
body: Built on `site-page`: `header`, `footer` and `announcement` are its props, and the `logo` and `actions` slots go to the header (`sheet-actions` too, in web components). `post.blocks` takes docs-blocks' blocks; `more` takes blog-card props.
